NATIONAL FOREWORD
This Indian Standard (First Revision) which is identical with IEC 62501 : 2024 'Voltage sourced converter (VSC) valves for high voltage direct current (HVDC) power transmission - Electrical testing' issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the HVDC Power Systems Sectional Committee and approval of the Electrotechnical Division Council.
IS 16075 was first published in 2013. This revision has been brought out to align it with the latest version of IEC 62501 : 2024.
